original_test_intent: Cycle approved PCIe endpoints through the required D3 state 10,000 times and verify every device wakes, re-enumerates if applicable, restores driver/service state and accumulates no errors.
original_method: Pin vendor module/config; define D3hot versus D3cold and wake source per endpoint; map safe allowlist/capabilities; preserve baseline power/link/enumeration/driver/log/I/O; approve dwell/cycle oracle; drain services; run with first-failure stop; restore original runtime-power policy and health.
manual_activity: Platform/power owner approves D3 substate and wake mechanism; operator drains endpoint I/O and owns recovery.
required_inputs: Endpoint D3hot/D3cold capability and wake matrix
I/O drain, runtime-policy restore and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never power down unbounded all-bridge scope
Stop on failed wake/enumeration, AER, I/O or management anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Restore policy/services and report without DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic vendor invocation lacks D3 substate, targets, wake source and 10,000-cycle checks.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use pinned vendor configuration on explicit capable endpoints with per-cycle D3 entry and wake/re-enumeration verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: D3-only focus and literal 10,000 loops are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Log requested/observed D3 state, wake event, presence, link, driver, service and error counters for every cycle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds substate/capability definition and policy restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The combined L1/D3 case cannot eliminate this D3-only endurance count.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: D3cold can remove auxiliary power and may require platform firmware or physical power sequencing to recover.

project_override_considerations: Platform owner decides D3hot versus D3cold scope and which endpoints have a validated wake path.
expected_evidence: Restored policy/final health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires 10,000 disruptive D3 cycles while Criteria only check readable text and firmware; log clearing conflicts with evidence retention.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row317 Wistron-NV GPU-00310-V003: define D3hot/D3cold target per endpoint, capability/wake matrix, safe allowlist, 10,000-loop timing and per-cycle enumeration/driver/error oracle plus runtime-policy recovery; preserve logs and map/replace unrelated Criteria.

review_improvement: Makes D3 semantics and wake success explicit rather than counting opaque proprietary iterations.
independent_technical_reasoning: D3hot retains auxiliary accessibility while D3cold may physically remove the device, so a single D3 label does not identify expected enumeration or wake behavior. The state and wake mechanism must be fixed per endpoint before endurance automation.
